description: List Agentropolis platform features with status (live, partial, stub, planned), endpoint and guardrails: badges, the x402 relay, seller claims and analytics, sponsored placement, market data, billing. Use it to check whether a platform capability exists before relying on it; it describes Agentropolis itself, not listings. Read-only, no parameters. Stub endpoints answer HTTP 501; payments_enabled shows whether Agentropolis charges for anything (currently false).
name: get_roadmap
title: List Agentropolis features and their status
